jobs.name: chat-day-recovery
jobs.description: Recheck unfinished stages every minute; duplicate starts are serialized

monitoring.retry: Invoke the same endpoint with an empty body; never supply a date. Recovery closes old dates in order and never redraws finalized days.

operations.setup: Register these schedules only in an approved environment. Resolve the service credential from the scheduler secret store, never from this file. No production deployment is implied.
